copies.app/lib/rss.server.ts: the podcast feed: iTunes and Podcasting 2.0 tags, OP3 enclosures and permanent episode guids, which Prelum's blog feeds do not write; the writing feed is Prelum's rssDocument
copies.scripts/feed-path-test.mjs: a check of the live podcast feed's path and tags before a cutover; it reads a feed, it does not build one
copies.public/_headers: not by hand: site-runtime-headers writes it on every build from the registry entry the Worker's set comes from (buildSecurityHeaders({ site: germomics })); committed so the /assets/* cache rule can be read
